column1: # What each regression sample must hold (tab separated): its name in the samples folder, then
#   all       every corpus file, at its corpus path ("all -dir/" leaves out the files under dir/)
#   a|b>c     just these corpus files ("from>as" when the archive names it differently)
#   baseline  whatever tests/baselines/<name>.sha256 says (no independent reference exists)
# Names containing "-pw" are encrypted with the password kz-test.

# Windows' tar (bsdtar), which crashes on the corpus's Unicode names, so is given everything else
